holdings.thesis: HOLD: shares popped another 3.3% today to ~$411 on continued reaction to the record Q2 FY27 beat (revenue $384M vs. $299M consensus, EPS $3.76 vs. $2.66 est.) -- the post-earnings rally is extending, not fading, with no new negative catalyst. Position remains small (3.1% of portfolio) after two prior stop-loss trims.

HOLD: price has stabilized around $165, essentially flat with yesterday's close, two trading days after the Q2 guidance-miss selloff. 19-analyst average PT remains $283 (4 Strong Buy, 14 Buy, 1 Hold, 0 Sell) and FY27 guidance still implies 85%+ revenue growth -- no new catalyst today, thesis for the remaining (already-trimmed) position is unchanged.

HOLD: thesis intact. JPMorgan raised its PT to $135 (kept Neutral) following Evercore's 9/1 Outperform upgrade to $210 -- incremental analyst support. The earnings-growth-decline flag remains attributable to AI-feature reinvestment per the Q2 print, not a demand slowdown; no new data today changes that read.

HOLD: shares roughly flat, no new insider-selling Form 4s or fresh CEO-transition news beyond what's already reflected in the two prior trims (~85% combined reduction). Position is minimal (1.4% of portfolio); will revisit if the 9/30/26 CEO transition brings new information.

HOLD: shares pulled back further intraday (down ~32% from the 52-week high, ~13% on renewed project-timing/execution concerns) but no new negative catalyst beyond the already-known securities-litigation overhang. Analyst sentiment stays firmly bullish (28 firms: 3 Strong Buy, 21 Buy, 4 Hold, 0 Sell) with Loop Capital's Street-high $500 PT implying ~100% upside -- a hold, not a further trim.

HOLD: thesis intact. The FTC's YouTube investigation (account-suspension/content-policy practices) is reported nearing its final stages -- an incremental regulatory item alongside the already-known Chrome/Android DOJ divestiture overhang, but not a new thesis break. Strong Buy consensus (58 buy, 0 sell, avg PT $428) and Cloud/AI momentum remain the core case; stock goes ex-dividend ($0.22) 9/4.

HOLD: thesis intact, no new catalyst today. The FTC's ad-surcharge lawsuit is a known, ongoing overhang rather than new information. Strong Buy consensus (59 buy, 0 sell, avg PT $328) and continued AWS/Zoox growth support the position.

HOLD: thesis intact and strengthening. Piper Sandler raised its PT to $185 (from $158, kept Neutral) following the Q3 dividend raise to $1.03/share and the new Louisiana Proxxima blending-expansion final investment decision.

HOLD: thesis strengthening further -- Goldman Sachs raised its PT to $115 (from $106) on 8/31 and BofA to $93 (from $88, kept Buy), both since the FQ4 beat, reinforcing the bull case with no new negative data today.

HOLD: return improved to -4.1% (from -6.5% yesterday) as shares partly recovered on sector strength tied to Snowflake's earnings beat. The deceleration flagged on the Q2 call in spend from its largest AI-native customer (OpenAI) remains the known driver of the post-earnings pullback -- not new information -- while FY26 guidance was still raised overall; AI-observability demand thesis intact.

HOLD: thesis intact, no new catalyst today. GLP-1 franchise strength and the raised FY26 guidance ($86B revenue / $36 EPS) continue to support the position; Merida Biosciences acquisition remains pending.

HOLD: shares +4.65% today after SoFi announced its SoFiUSD stablecoin will list on Kraken's (Payward) platform, plus Scotiabank's new Outperform initiation -- a positive incremental catalyst on top of unchanged Q2 fundamentals (revenue +40% YoY, record member/product adds). The prior rate-sensitivity watch item is unchanged, not worsened.

HOLD: thesis intact, no new negative catalyst. New FieldAI partnership on physical-AI/robotics adds to the existing NVIDIA autonomous-equipment collaboration; Bernstein maintains Hold but broader consensus (14 buy, 2 sell) stays Buy with a $975.61 average PT.

HOLD: thesis intact. IonQ added two new board members (finance veteran Dr. Eric Ball, former Samsung NA CEO Timothy Baxter) in a governance-strengthening move; no new negative developments. The 9/30/26 public-warrant expiration remains the known near-term dilution watch item.
